opening.argument: The video presents an in-depth tutorial on using Coinbase to buy and sell cryptocurrency, configure security features, and navigate the exchange through its app and website. Visible demonstrations show Coinbase buy, send, sell, price-alert, and security interfaces, while the speaker recommends phone verification and an authenticator app. Although the description includes a referral invitation and directs viewers to a separate Bitconnect video about sending Bitcoin, buying BCC, and making a loan, the evidence supplies no concrete deceptive return claim and does not establish misrepresentation of the destination. The record therefore supports an educational Coinbase demonstration with promotional elements, rather than a confirmed deceptive solicitation.
